title: Paul Hellyer briefed by Greer, press conference in Toronto

tellings.link_reason: Both are about Paul Hellyer, Canada's former defence minister, going public about UFOs.

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner for government openness about UFOs, says he was one of the reasons Paul Hellyer, a former Canadian minister of defence, began speaking publicly about the subject in the 2000s. Greer says he briefed Hellyer and that the two held a press conference together in Toronto, and he mentions The Day After Roswell, a book by Philip J. Corso. It matters because it would mean a senior former official was persuaded to speak out.
